content:
John,
    
    To the seven churches in the province of Asia:
    
    Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 2

content:
and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth.
    
    
    To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 2

content: who testifies to everything he saw—that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 1

content: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 1

content: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow, and his eyes were like blazing fire.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: In his right hand he held seven stars, and coming out of his mouth was a sharp, double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: “Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: The mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and of the seven golden lampstands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 1

content: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father—to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 2

content:
“Look, he is coming with the clouds,”
    and “every eye will see him,
  even those who pierced him”;
    and all peoples on earth “will mourn because of him.”
    So shall it be! Amen.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 2

content: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.”

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 2

content: On the Lord’s Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: which said: “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.”

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: and among the lampstands was someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: I am the Living One; I was dead, and now look, I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.

teaching.name: The person of Jesus Christ 3

content: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: “Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: Then I was told, “You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, “There will be no more delay!

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but ‘in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.’”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 1

content: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content:
The nations were angry,
    and your wrath has come.
  The time has come for judging the dead,
    and for rewarding your servants the prophets
  and your people who revere your name,
    both great and small—
  and for destroying those who destroy the earth.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content: Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a severe hailstorm.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3
Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content: They have power to shut up the heavens so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: Their bodies will lie in the public square of the great city—which is figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where also their Lord was crucified.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: For three and a half days some from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content:
saying:
  “We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty,
    the One who is and who was,
  because you have taken your great power
    and have begun to reign.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, with its worshipers.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: They are “the two olive trees” and the two lampstands, and “they stand before the Lord of the earth.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: Now when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them, and overpower and kill them.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: But after the three and a half days the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 2

content: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content:
The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said:
  “The kingdom of the world has become
    the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah,
    and he will reign for ever and ever.”

teaching.name: Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3
Interlude between sixth and seventh trumpet 3

content: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on its heads.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who “will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content:
They triumphed over him
    by the blood of the Lamb
    and by the word of their testimony;
  they did not love their lives so much
    as to shrink from death.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and flung them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it might devour her child the moment he was born.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent’s reach.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel
Michael the arch angel

content: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content:
Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say:
  “Now have come the salvation and the power
    and the kingdom of our God,
    and the authority of his Messiah.
  For the accuser of our brothers and sisters,
    who accuses them before our God day and night,
    has been hurled down.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

teaching.name: The Woman and the Red Dragon

content: The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content:
Therefore rejoice, you heavens
    and you who dwell in them!
  But woe to the earth and the sea,
    because the devil has gone down to you!
  He is filled with fury,
    because he knows that his time is short.”

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who keep God’s commands and hold fast their testimony about Jesus.

teaching.name: Michael the arch angel

content: It was given power to wage war against God’s holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: Whoever has ears, let them hear.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: The dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.

teaching.name: Introduction: Wild beast out of sea and earth

content: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

teaching.name: Introduction: Wild beast out of sea and earth

content: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, “Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?”

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written in the Lamb’s book of life, the Lamb who was slain from the creation of the world.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth
Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: The beast was given a mouth to utter proud words and blasphemies and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content:
“If anyone is to go into captivity,
    into captivity they will go.
  If anyone is to be killed with the sword,
    with the sword they will be killed.”
This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God’s people.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.

teaching.name: Wild beast out of the sea and earth

content: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language and people.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: He said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: A second angel followed and said, “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great,’ which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: they, too, will drink the wine of God’s fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God who keep his commands and remain faithful to Jesus.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, “Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2
Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content:
Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.”
    “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, “Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth’s vine, because its grapes are ripe.”

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1

content: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or on their hand,

teaching.name: Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 1
Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2
Looking to the end of the great Tribulation 2

content: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues—last, because with them God’s wrath is completed.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content:
and sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb:
  “Great and marvelous are your deeds,
    Lord God Almighty.
  Just and true are your ways,
    King of the nations.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content:
Who will not fear you, Lord,
    and bring glory to your name?
  For you alone are holy.
  All nations will come
    and worship before you,
  for your righteous acts have been revealed.”

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: After this I looked, and I saw in heaven the temple—that is, the tabernacle of the covenant law—and it was opened.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held harps given them by God

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

teaching.name: Preparation for the final judgement

content: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly, festering sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content:
And I heard the altar respond:
  “Yes, Lord God Almighty,
    true and just are your judgments.”

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath
The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content:
for they have shed the blood of your holy people and your prophets,
    and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve.”

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they refused to repent of what they had done.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: They are demonic spirits that perform signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath on the earth.”

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to scorch people with fire.

teaching.name: The first four bowls of God's Wrath

content: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since mankind has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: Every island fled away and the mountains could not be found.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: From the sky huge hailstones, each weighing about a hundred pounds, fell on people. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: Then I saw three impure spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: “Look, I come like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and remains clothed, so as not to go naked and be shamefully exposed.”

teaching.name: The fifth, sixth and seventh bowls of God's Wrath

content: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits by many waters.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content:
The name written on her forehead was a mystery:
    Babylon the Great
    the Mother of Prostitutes
    and of the Abominations of the Earth.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content:
I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus.
    When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content: Then the angel said to me: “Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content: The beast who once was, and now is not, is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to his destruction.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings—and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers.”

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: “The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery, and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries.”

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will bring her to ruin and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to hand over to the beast their royal authority, until God’s words are fulfilled.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 1

content: The beast, which you saw, once was, now is not, and yet will come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth whose names have not been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be astonished when they see the beast, because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content: “This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.

teaching.name: The Apostate church in the great tribulation 2

content:
With a mighty voice he shouted:
  “ ‘Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great!’
    She has become a dwelling for demons
  and a haunt for every impure spirit,
    a haunt for every unclean bird,
    a haunt for every unclean and detestable animal.

teaching.name: Political and commercial Babylon is Judged 1

content:
Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her:
    death, mourning and famine.

teaching.name: Introduction to Revelation Part 1

content: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”

teaching.name: Introduction to Revelation Part 1

content:
“To the angel of the church in Sardis write:
    
    These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars.
    
    I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

teaching.name: Christ's letter to the Church in Sardis

content: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.

teaching.name: Christ's letter to the Church in Sardis

content: To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I was victorious and sat down with my Father on his throne.

teaching.name: Introduction to Revelation Part 1

content: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.”

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ Jesus

content: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ Jesus

content: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to him who sits on the throne and who lives for ever and ever,

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. In front of the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content:
Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying:
    “ ‘Holy, holy, holy
    is the Lord God Almighty,’
    who was, and is, and is to come.”

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content:
“You are worthy, our Lord and God,
    to receive glory and honor and power,
  for you created all things,
    and by your will they were created
    and have their being.”

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and ruby. A rainbow that shone like an emerald encircled the throne.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ Jesus

content:
Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal.
    In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 1

content: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 2

content: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 2

content: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 2

content: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God’s people.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content:
And they sang a new song, saying:
  “You are worthy to take the scroll
    and to open its seals,
  because you were slain,
    and with your blood you purchased for God
    persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content:
You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God,
    and they will reign on the earth.”

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content:
Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, saying:
  “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb
    be praise and honor and glory and power,
    for ever and ever!”

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

teaching.name: The Church in Heaven with Christ 2

content: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing at the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content:
In a loud voice they were saying:
  “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain,
    to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength
    and honor and glory and praise!”

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: The four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.

teaching.name: Christ: the Lion and the Lamb

content: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, “Two pounds of wheat for a day’s wages, and six pounds of barley for a day’s wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: They called out in a loud voice, “How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, were killed just as they had been.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: They called to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: I looked, and there before me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: and the stars in the sky fell to earth, as figs drop from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: The heavens receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?”

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. To him was given a large sword.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and everyone else, both slave and free, hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

teaching.name: Introduction: Opening of the first six seals

content: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.

teaching.name: Remnant of Israel sealed

content: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

teaching.name: Remnant of Israel sealed

content: Then one of the elders asked me, “These in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?”

teaching.name: Remnant of Israel sealed
Great multitude in White Robes

content: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.

teaching.name: God Seals a remnant of Israel

content: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

teaching.name: God Seals a remnant of Israel

content:
And they cried out in a loud voice:
  “Salvation belongs to our God,
  who sits on the throne,
  and to the Lamb.”

teaching.name: Remnant of Israel sealed

content:
I answered, “Sir, you know.”
    And he said, “These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

teaching.name: Great multitude in White Robes

content:
For the Lamb at the center of the throne
    will be their shepherd;
  ‘he will lead them to springs of living water.’
    ‘And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”

teaching.name: Great multitude in White Robes
Great multitude in White Robes
Great multitude in White Robes

content: “Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”

teaching.name: God Seals a remnant of Israel

content:
saying:
  “Amen!
  Praise and glory
  and wisdom and thanks and honor
  and power and strength
  be to our God for ever and ever.
  Amen!”

teaching.name: Remnant of Israel sealed

content:
Therefore,
  “they are before the throne of God
    and serve him day and night in his temple;
  and he who sits on the throne
    will shelter them with his presence.

teaching.name: Great multitude in White Robes

content:
‘Never again will they hunger;
    never again will they thirst.
  The sun will not beat down on them,’
    nor any scorching heat.

teaching.name: Great multitude in White Robes
Great multitude in White Robes
Great multitude in White Robes

content: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water—

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: the name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter, and many people died from the waters that had become bitter.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all God’s people, on the golden altar in front of the throne.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God’s people, went up before God from the angel’s hand.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 1

content: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: “Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!”

teaching.name: The Opening of the seventh seal 2

content: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: And out of the smoke locusts came down on the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: They had tails with stingers, like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails were like snakes, having heads with which they inflict injury.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: The rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.

teaching.name: Introduction to Revelation Part 1

content: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: During those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: They had as king over them the angel of the Abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon and in Greek is Apollyon (that is, Destroyer).

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: The number of the mounted troops was twice ten thousand times ten thousand. I heard their number.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: They were not allowed to kill them but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 1

content: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar that is before God.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2

content: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.

teaching.name: Fifth and Sixth trumpets 2
